judgment.rationale: The report says Ctrl+F1/F2 media shortcuts stop working after a period, Fn+pause also fails, and Ctrl itself later stops working until Keyboard Manager is disabled. This resembles the symptom in #34714 but is not linked or confirmed as the same failure; exact trigger timing and current version are missing.
evidence: The author reports PowerToys 0.96.1 and mappings Ctrl+F1→Last Track and Ctrl+F2→Next Track.
The issue also describes a built-in Fn+pause failure and a later global Ctrl failure, reversed by disabling Keyboard Manager.
There are no comments, assignees, or linked work; #34714 is a related stuck-Ctrl report, not a confirmed duplicate.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask whether the current failure is the global Ctrl loss or only the media mappings and what event precedes it.

fix_assessment.rationale: The report combines media-key failures, a built-in Fn shortcut, and global Ctrl loss; current-version status and the transition between them are not isolated.

issue_context.summary: Ctrl+F1/F2 media remaps and a built-in Fn+pause shortcut reportedly stop working, followed by global Ctrl failure; disabling Keyboard Manager restores Ctrl.
known_information: Reported on PowerToys 0.96.1, installed from GitHub and Microsoft Store.
The reporter uses two monitors and notices the media shortcut failure after some time.
The report has no comments or direct linked work; #34714 has a related stuck-Ctrl symptom.
inferences: The global Ctrl symptom may be a stuck-modifier condition, but the media-key and Fn shortcut failures may be independent.
issue_context.analysis: A focused clarification should separate the sequence of media remap loss from global Ctrl failure and establish whether it persists on a current build. Avoid treating the unlinked #34714 report as a confirmed duplicate or requesting logs before narrowing the sequence.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue body and checked current comments, labels, assignees, and linked work.
Compared the reported global Ctrl symptom with #34714; the reports are related but no duplicate relationship is established.

information_gaps.information: Whether a current build still shows only media mapping loss or the subsequent global Ctrl failure, and the sequence of events leading to each.
information_gaps.why_needed: This determines whether to investigate a media-key mapping issue or the stuck-modifier path, which may have different causes.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Confirm the current PowerToys version, then state whether Ctrl+F1/F2 fails before ordinary Ctrl shortcuts do, whether Fn+pause is affected at the same time, and whether the failure follows a monitor/focus transition.

actions.label: Separate media remap loss from Ctrl failure

comment.body:
Thanks for the detailed Ctrl+F1/F2, Fn+pause, and Ctrl symptoms. The report combines loss of the media mappings with a later global Ctrl failure, which may be a different path than the media shortcuts themselves.

Please confirm the current PowerToys version and, if this still occurs, say whether Ctrl+F1/F2 stops first, whether ordinary Ctrl shortcuts fail at the same time, and whether Fn+pause fails in that same interval. Also note whether a monitor/focus change precedes it. This will distinguish a media mapping issue from the stuck-Ctrl behavior reported separately in #34714; no generic log upload is requested.
